feature.name: Site Navigation & Language
feature.description: How a visitor enters the site by URL, moves between its sections (home, company, sectors, commitments, contact), browses the six trades (metiers) and the company sub-pages, enlarges photos, opens social profiles, and switches between French and English. Captured from the production single-page site: five panels driven by js/custom.js, AJAX fragments re-bound by js/innercustom.js, and a CSS hover menu.

surfaces.name: Page Request
surfaces.description: The HTTP request that loads the single page (index.php). Query parameters lg and msg decide language and starting section; hosting redirects http and www variants.

actions.name: Open Page
actions.intent: Load index.php. lg=en gives English, anything else (fr, missing, or an unknown value such as contact) gives French. Any msg value opens the contact section; without msg the page starts at home.

parameters.name: lg
parameters.description: The lg query parameter: fr, en, another value, or absent.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: The msg query parameter set after a form submission: absent (none), success, success_en or any other value.

effect.description: Serve English.

rules.description: lg=en selects English.

effect.description: Serve French.

rules.description: Every other lg value, or none, falls back to French.

effect.description: Start on the home panel.

rules.description: Without msg the page opens on home.

effect.description: Start on the contact panel.

rules.description: Any msg value opens the contact panel on load.

actions.name: Give every section its own web address
actions.intent: Each section and trade gets a real URL in both languages, so it can be linked, bookmarked, shared and indexed.

evolution.rationale: Today every link lands on the home panel and search engines only see one page per language.

actions.name: Open the menu with a real button
actions.intent: A labelled button opens and closes the menu, works with keyboard and touch, and announces its state.

evolution.rationale: The menu currently appears only on hover, so keyboard users cannot reach it and touch users rely on browser quirks.

actions.name: Keep the visitor on the same page when switching language
actions.intent: Switching language opens the same section or trade in the other language.

evolution.rationale: A visitor reading about smoke control in French should not be sent back to the English home page.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Indexed URLs keep resolving
acceptanceCriteria.when: a crawler or bookmark requests any of them
acceptanceCriteria.then: it gets the page in the right language, directly or through a permanent redirect

acceptanceCriteria.title: Each language has its own title and description
acceptanceCriteria.then: each carries a title, meta description and html lang in its own language
acceptanceCriteria.description: Current titles and descriptions are listed in the audit, section 6.

acceptanceCriteria.title: All captured content stays available in both languages
